privacyPolicy.title: Privacy Policy
privacyPolicy.intro: This policy explains how {brandLegalName} handles personal data on the {brandName} platform. It is written to be read in full: sections 2, 3 and 4 define who is answerable for what.

scope.title: Scope of this policy
scope.content:
This policy applies to the {brandName} platform, operated by {brandLegalName}, registered under CNPJ {brandCnpj}, and to all sites, applications and interfaces made available at {siteUrl}.

{brandName} is a business communication platform: companies subscribe in order to talk to their own customers over WhatsApp, Instagram, Telegram and live chat, supported by AI agents, a CRM and campaign tooling.

That means two distinct groups of people appear in the platform, and this policy addresses them separately:

• Platform users: people who hold an account and sign in (administrators, managers and agents of subscribing companies).
• Contacts: people who talk to a subscribing company through a connected channel, without necessarily having any relationship with {brandLegalName}.

roles.title: Our two roles: controller and processor
roles.content:
This is the most important section of this policy. {brandLegalName} acts in two distinct roles under the Brazilian General Data Protection Law (Law 13.709/2018):

1. As CONTROLLER, when we determine the purposes and means of processing. This covers registration, authentication, billing, support and security data for platform users. In these cases we are directly answerable and the data subject should contact us.

2. As PROCESSOR, when we process personal data on behalf of and under the instructions of a subscribing company. This covers conversation content, imported contacts, service records and everything the subscribing company chooses to collect and store in its workspace. Here the subscribing company is the controller: it decides why and how that data is processed, and the data subject should approach it first.

If you spoke to a company over WhatsApp, Instagram, Telegram or chat and want to know why your data is processed, that company answers, not {brandLegalName}. Even so, if you contact us we will forward your request to the responsible controller and tell you that we have done so (see section 13).

controllerData.title: Data we process as controller
controllerData.content:
As controller, we process the following platform-user data:

• Registration and identification: name, work email, phone, role, company and the workspace the user belongs to.
• Authentication and security: credentials in hashed form, session tokens, IP address, device and browser identification, access timestamps and security event logs.
• Billing: subscribing company registration details, contracted plan, add-ons, balance, invoices and payment history.
• Platform usage: technical records of features accessed, volume of messages and calls processed, errors and diagnostics.
• Support: the content of tickets you open with us and the support conversation history.

We do not collect sensitive personal data from platform users and do not request it in any registration form.

operatorData.title: Data we process as processor
operatorData.content:
As processor, we store and process, under the subscribing company's instructions:

• Conversation content: text, audio, images, video and documents exchanged between the subscribing company and its contacts on connected channels, including audio transcriptions where that feature is enabled.
• Contact identifiers: phone number, display name, social account identifier and profile picture, as supplied by the originating channel.
• Service records: assignment history, funnel stages, labels, notes, opportunities and any other fields the subscribing company configures.
• WhatsApp call records: metadata such as date, time, duration and outcome.
• Knowledge bases: documents and text the subscribing company uploads to ground AI agent responses.

We do not use this data for our own purposes. We do not sell it, do not transfer it to third parties for commercial purposes and do not use it for advertising. Its use is limited to delivering the contracted service, securing the platform and meeting legal obligations.

lawfulBasis.title: Lawful bases
lawfulBasis.content:
As controller, we process personal data on the following lawful bases under article 7 of the LGPD:

• Performance of a contract (item V): to create and maintain accounts, deliver contracted features, bill and provide support.
• Compliance with a legal or regulatory obligation (item II): to meet tax and accounting obligations and orders from competent authorities.
• Legitimate interests (item IX): to secure the platform, prevent fraud and abuse, and improve service stability and performance, always weighed against your rights.
• Consent (item I): only where requested specifically and prominently, such as marketing communications, and always revocable.

As processor, we do not determine the lawful basis: it is set by the subscribing company, which represents that it holds an adequate basis for the processing it instructs us to perform, including, where applicable, the contact's consent to receive messages.

howWeUse.title: How we use data
howWeUse.content:
We use the data described in sections 3 and 4 to:

• Provide, maintain and operate the platform and its channel integrations.
• Authenticate users, enforce permissions and log access.
• Process payments, calculate consumption and issue invoices.
• Provide technical support and answer requests.
• Detect, investigate and contain fraud, abuse, unauthorised messaging and security incidents.
• Produce aggregate statistics on platform performance and usage, in a form that does not identify data subjects.
• Meet legal obligations and respond to requests from authorities.

We do not carry out automated decisions with legal effects on data subjects beyond what the subscribing company configures in its own service and automation flows.

ai.title: Artificial intelligence and message content
ai.content:
The platform offers AI agents that read and answer messages on connected text channels. This should be explicit:

• Message content is sent to language model providers to generate responses, suggestions, summaries, audio transcriptions and classifications. This transfer is necessary for the feature to work.
• Those providers act as sub-processors and are contractually bound to process the content solely to carry out the request, without using it to train their own models.
• AI features operate exclusively on messaging channels. The platform does not place automated AI voice calls, and no AI agent conducts telephone calls.
• AI-generated responses may contain errors. They do not constitute legal, financial, medical or professional advice, and the subscribing company is responsible for reviewing and supervising their use.
• The subscribing company chooses whether, when and in which conversations agents operate, and can disable them.

channels.title: Third-party channels
channels.content:
The platform connects to channels operated by third parties. When you use them, data also travels through those providers' infrastructure, subject to their policies:

• WhatsApp Business Platform, Instagram and other Meta Platforms, Inc. services.
• Telegram Messenger.

When a subscribing company connects an account on these channels, authorisation is granted directly to the provider, and the originating platform's rules then apply to message traffic, including its consent requirements, service windows and content policies.

We do not control these providers' privacy practices. We recommend reading each provider's privacy policy.

subprocessors.title: Sub-processors and international transfers
subprocessors.content:
To operate the platform we rely on suppliers that may process personal data on our behalf, in the following categories:

• Cloud infrastructure and hosting.
• Artificial intelligence model and audio transcription providers.
• The messaging channel providers described in section 8.
• Payment processors and tax document issuers.
• Monitoring, error logging and customer communication tools.

Some of these suppliers are located outside Brazil, which constitutes an international transfer of data. We carry out these transfers on the basis of article 33 of the LGPD, under contractual clauses requiring a standard of protection compatible with Brazilian law.

An up-to-date list of sub-processors can be requested at {dpoEmail}.

sharing.title: Data sharing
sharing.content:
We do not sell personal data. We share data only in the following cases:

• With the sub-processors described in section 9, to the extent necessary to deliver the service.
• With the subscribing company responsible for the workspace, where we act as processor.
• With public authorities, upon a valid legal request, court order or regulatory obligation.
• To exercise or defend rights in judicial, administrative or arbitration proceedings.
• In a corporate transaction such as a merger, acquisition or reorganisation, in which case the acquirer remains bound by this policy and data subjects will be informed.

In every case we share the minimum necessary for the purpose.

security.title: Information security
security.content:
We apply technical and administrative measures to protect personal data, including:

• Encryption in transit on all connections to the platform.
• Credential storage using key derivation functions, with no plaintext password retention.
• Logical segregation by workspace, so that one subscribing company cannot access another's data.
• Role and permission based access control, with logging of relevant events.
• Sessions authenticated by session cookies with security attributes, revoked on sign-out.

No system is entirely immune to incidents. Should a security incident occur with material risk to data subjects, we will notify the Brazilian Data Protection Authority and the affected data subjects within the deadlines and in the form required by applicable law, and describe the measures taken.

retention.title: Retention and deletion
retention.content:
We retain personal data for as long as necessary for the purposes in this policy:

• Account and usage data: while the account remains active.
• Conversation data and service records: for the period configured by the subscribing company or for the duration of the contract, whichever comes first.
• Tax and billing data: for the period required by Brazilian tax law.
• Application access logs: for the period set out in the Brazilian Internet Civil Framework (Law 12.965/2014).

On termination, the subscribing company may request an export of its data. After the recovery period stated in the contract, data is deleted or anonymised, except where retention is mandatory under article 16 of the LGPD.

rights.title: Your rights
rights.content:
Under article 18 of the LGPD you may request at any time:

• Confirmation that processing exists, and access to the data.
• Correction of incomplete, inaccurate or outdated data.
• Anonymisation, blocking or deletion of unnecessary or excessive data, or data processed unlawfully.
• Portability to another provider, subject to commercial and industrial secrecy.
• Deletion of data processed on the basis of consent.
• Information about the entities with which we share data.
• Information about the option not to give consent and the consequences of refusal.
• Withdrawal of consent.
• Review of automated decisions affecting your interests.

How to exercise them: write to {dpoEmail}. We will respond within the statutory deadline. We may request additional information to confirm your identity, solely to avoid disclosing data to the wrong person.

If the request concerns data we process as processor (for example a conversation you had with a company that uses the platform), we will forward it to the controlling company and tell you that we have done so.

cookies.title: Cookies and similar technologies
cookies.content:
We use cookies and browser local storage to:

• Keep your session authenticated and apply your account settings, such as language, theme and display preferences. These are strictly necessary and cannot be disabled without breaking the platform.
• Measure stability and performance, in aggregate.

The authenticated platform does not use advertising cookies or cross-site tracking for marketing. You may block cookies in your browser settings, bearing in mind that blocking necessary cookies will prevent sign-in.

children.title: Children and adolescents
children.content:
The platform is intended exclusively for professional use by people aged 18 or over. We do not create accounts for minors and do not direct the service at that audience.

If we identify that a child's or adolescent's data has been registered as a platform user without an adequate legal basis, the record will be deleted. If you become aware of such a situation, please contact {dpoEmail}.

dpo.title: Data Protection Officer

changes.title: Changes to this policy
changes.content:
We may update this policy to reflect changes in the platform, in the law or in our suppliers.

Where a change is material (for example a new processing purpose or a new category of sub-processor), we will notify platform users by email or by an in-product notice, a reasonable time before the change takes effect.

The date of the last update is shown at the top of this page. Previous versions can be requested at {dpoEmail}.

termsOfService.title: Terms of Use
termsOfService.intro: These terms govern use of the {brandName} platform. Sections 5, 6 and 7 define what you may send, under whose rules, and who answers for the consent of the person receiving it. Read them before sending any message.

agreement.title: Contracting and acceptance
agreement.content:
These Terms of Use are entered into between {brandLegalName}, CNPJ {brandCnpj} ("we"), and the legal entity that subscribes to the {brandName} platform ("you" or the "subscribing company").

Acceptance occurs upon the first of the following events: account creation, signature of a commercial proposal or the start of use of the platform. By accepting, you declare that you have the authority to bind the legal entity you represent.

If a signed commercial agreement exists between the parties, it prevails over these terms wherever they conflict. In all other matters, the two documents complement each other.

The platform is intended for professional use by legal entities. It is not offered to individual consumers for personal use.

definitions.title: Definitions
definitions.content:
• Platform: the {brandName} software, its interfaces, APIs and integrations.
• Workspace: the isolated environment that holds a subscribing company's data, users and channels.
• User: a person authorized by the subscribing company to access the platform.
• Contact: a person the subscribing company talks to through a connected channel.
• Channel: a messaging service integrated with the platform, such as WhatsApp Business, Instagram, Telegram or live chat.
• AI agent: an artificial intelligence feature that reads and answers messages on text channels.
• Subscribing company content: messages, contacts, documents, knowledge bases and other data that the subscribing company enters or generates on the platform.

account.title: Account, users and credentials
account.content:
You are responsible for:

• Keeping registration details accurate and up to date.
• Defining the users of your workspace and their respective roles and permissions.
• Ensuring the confidentiality of credentials and not sharing them between people.
• Revoking access for departed users immediately.

Every act performed by an authenticated user is attributed to the subscribing company. If you identify unauthorized access, notify {supportEmail} immediately.

We may refuse to create accounts or require additional verification when there are signs of fraud, use prohibited by these terms or a breach of channel rules.

plans.title: Plans, balance and billing
plans.content:
Use of the platform depends on a subscribed plan and, for certain features, on an available balance.

• Usage-based features (such as messages, bulk sends, WhatsApp call minutes, audio transcription and use of artificial intelligence models) are debited from the balance according to the current price table.
• Without sufficient balance, usage-dependent features are interrupted until the balance is topped up, and this does not constitute a service failure.
• Amounts paid for usage already consumed are non-refundable.
• Price adjustments and changes will be communicated at least 30 days in advance, and you may terminate the contract before the new price takes effect.
• Applicable taxes are added as required by law.

Non-payment authorizes suspension of access after prior notice, under section 13.

acceptableUse.title: Acceptable use
acceptableUse.content:
You may not use the platform to:

• Send unsolicited messages, whether in bulk or not, to anyone who has not expressed interest in receiving them.
• Engage in spam, phishing, social engineering, fraud or any form of deceptively obtaining data or payments.
• Distribute malware or content that compromises third-party systems.
• Publish content that is unlawful, discriminatory, incites violence or infringes third-party rights, including intellectual property.
• Impersonate third parties or suggest a nonexistent affiliation with people, brands or public bodies.
• Carry out debt collection that is abusive, threatening or exposes the debtor to embarrassment, in breach of the Brazilian Consumer Protection Code.
• Circumvent technical limits, quotas, queues or security mechanisms of the platform or the channels.
• Reverse engineer, extract source code or resell access without written authorization.

These conducts authorize immediate suspension, as set out in section 13.

channelRules.title: Third-party channel rules
channelRules.content:
The platform connects to channels operated by third parties, including WhatsApp Business Platform and Instagram, from Meta Platforms, Inc., and Telegram.

When you connect an account, you also become bound by the policies of that channel's provider, which apply directly to you and may change without our involvement. Depending on the channel, this includes:

• Requirements for the recipient's prior consent.
• Rules on the service window and on the use of approved message templates.
• Content policies and prohibited business categories.
• Volume and quality limits, including phone number quality ratings.

The channel provider may, at its sole discretion, limit, suspend or ban a number or account. We have no control over that decision and are not liable for it. We recommend that you keep alternative channels for contacting your customers.

Known platform restrictions are shown in the interface where applicable, and do not constitute a defect in the service.

contactConsent.title: Contact consent and responsibility
contactConsent.content:
This section sets out the most significant allocation of responsibility in these terms.

You represent and warrant that, for each contact you enter, import or reach through the platform:

• You have an adequate legal basis to process that personal data and to send the intended communication.
• You have obtained, where required by law or by the channel rules, the recipient's prior, free, informed and verifiable consent.
• You keep a record capable of proving that consent, and are able to present it if questioned.
• You honor unsubscribe requests immediately and do not contact again anyone who has objected.

{brandLegalName} does not verify, does not validate and has no way of verifying the origin of contact lists or the existence of consent. We provide the tool; the decision about who receives which message is yours alone.

You are the controller of this personal data and are answerable to data subjects, authorities and third parties for any communication sent in breach of this section.

ai.title: Artificial intelligence: nature and limits
ai.content:
The platform provides artificial intelligence agents that operate on text messaging channels.

What you need to know when you activate them:

• Responses are generated by language models and may contain information that is incorrect, outdated or inappropriate for the context. There is no guarantee of accuracy.
• Responses do not constitute legal, financial, accounting, medical or professional advice of any kind.
• You are responsible for configuring, reviewing and supervising the behavior of the agents, including the content of the knowledge bases you provide.
• You are responsible for the content actually sent to your contacts, even when generated by an agent.
• To operate the feature, message content is sent to model providers, as described in the Privacy Policy.
• Artificial intelligence agents operate only on messaging channels. The platform does not make automated AI voice calls, and no agent conducts phone calls.

If the laws applicable to your sector require automated service to be identified as such, it is up to you to configure that.

customerData.title: Subscribing company content and data protection
customerData.content:
The subscribing company's content remains its property. We claim no ownership over it.

With respect to personal data contained in the subscribing company's content, we act as processors and you act as controller, under Law 13.709/2018. We process this data exclusively according to your instructions and as necessary to provide the service, maintain security and comply with the law.

You grant us a limited, non-exclusive and revocable license to host, process, transmit and display the subscribing company's content, solely to operate the platform on your behalf.

Details on data categories, sub-processors, international transfers, retention and data subject rights are set out in the Privacy Policy, which forms part of these terms.

While the contract is in force you may export your data using the available features. The conditions for retrieval after termination are set out in section 13.

availability.title: Availability, support and maintenance
availability.content:
We strive to keep the platform continuously available, but we do not guarantee uninterrupted or error-free operation.

Availability may be affected by:

• Scheduled maintenance, announced in advance whenever possible.
• Emergency security fixes, which may occur without prior notice.
• Unavailability, modification or discontinuation of third-party channels and services.
• Force majeure events and circumstances beyond our reasonable control.

Specific service level commitments, where they exist, will be set out in a commercial agreement or a dedicated annex. In their absence, the platform is provided on a best-efforts basis.

Support is provided through the channels indicated on the platform and at {supportEmail}.

intellectualProperty.title: Intellectual property
intellectualProperty.content:
The platform, its code, interfaces, documentation, trademarks and other elements are owned by {brandLegalName} or its licensors, and remain protected by applicable law.

We grant you a limited, non-exclusive, non-transferable and revocable license to use it, restricted to the term of the contract and to the purposes set out in these terms.

You may not copy, modify, distribute, sublicense, reverse engineer or create derivative works of the platform, except with written authorization or express legal permission.

Suggestions and feedback you send us about the product may be used freely by us, without any obligation of compensation and without this transferring any rights over your content.

confidentiality.title: Confidentiality
confidentiality.content:
Each party undertakes to keep confidential any confidential information of the other party to which it has access, using it only to fulfill these terms.

Information is not considered confidential if it: is or becomes public without a breach of these terms; was already known to the receiving party without an obligation of confidentiality; is independently developed; or must be disclosed by law or by a competent authority, in which case the party will notify the other where permitted.

The confidentiality obligation survives for 5 (five) years after the end of the contract.

suspension.title: Suspension and termination
suspension.content:
We may suspend or limit access, in whole or in part, when:

• There is non-payment that remains uncured after prior notice.
• There is a breach of sections 5, 6 or 7, in which case the suspension may be immediate.
• There is a concrete risk to the security of the platform, third parties or contacts.
• A competent authority orders it or a channel provider requires it.

You may terminate the contract at any time through the means provided on the platform or by writing to {supportEmail}.

Once the contract ends: access ceases; you may request an export of the subscribing company content within the retrieval period stated in the contract; after that period, the data is deleted or anonymized, except where retention is legally required.

Sections 10, 11, 12, 14, 15, 18 and 19 survive termination.

warranties.title: Warranties and disclaimers
warranties.content:
The platform is provided as is and as available.

To the maximum extent permitted by applicable law, we make no implied warranties of fitness for a particular purpose, commercial results, sales volume, message delivery rate, conversion or debt recovery.

Specifically, we do not guarantee:

• That messages will be delivered, read or answered, since delivery depends on the channel, the device and the recipient.
• That a number or account will remain active on a third-party channel.
• The accuracy of artificial intelligence generated content.

Nothing in these terms excludes warranties that mandatory Brazilian law does not allow to be excluded.

liability.title: Limitation of liability
liability.content:
To the maximum extent permitted by applicable law, the total aggregate liability of {brandLegalName} arising from these terms, for any cause, is limited to the amount actually paid by you in the 12 (twelve) months prior to the event giving rise to the claim.

We are not liable for lost profits, loss of opportunity, loss of data resulting from an act or omission of the subscribing company, indirect damages or damages arising from:

• Suspension, banning or rule changes by a third-party channel provider.
• Content sent by you or your users to your contacts.
• Use of artificial intelligence generated content without review.
• Lack of valid consent from contacts, under section 7.

These limitations do not apply to willful misconduct or gross negligence, nor do they exclude liabilities that mandatory Brazilian law imposes and that cannot be excluded.

indemnity.title: Indemnification
indemnity.content:
You agree to defend, indemnify and hold {brandLegalName} harmless from claims, administrative penalties, judgments, costs and reasonable attorneys' fees arising from:

• Communications sent by you in breach of section 7, including complaints from data subjects and proceedings by the ANPD, consumer protection agencies or sector authorities.
• A breach of sections 5 or 6.
• Subscribing company content that infringes third-party rights.

We will promptly notify you of any claim covered by this section and will cooperate in the defense, at your expense.

changes.title: Changes to the terms and the platform
changes.content:
We may change these terms to reflect legal, regulatory, product or supplier changes.

Material changes will be communicated by email or by a notice on the platform at least 30 days in advance. If you do not agree, you may terminate the contract before the changes take effect, with no additional charge beyond amounts already owed.

Continued use after the effective date constitutes acceptance.

The platform evolves: features may be added, changed or discontinued. Material discontinuations will be communicated with reasonable advance notice.

governingLaw.title: Governing law and jurisdiction
governingLaw.content:
These terms are governed by the laws of the Federative Republic of Brazil.

The parties elect the courts of the judicial district where {brandLegalName} is headquartered to settle disputes arising from these terms, waiving any other, however privileged it may be.

Before taking legal action, the parties will seek an amicable resolution through written communication, with a period of 30 (thirty) days for negotiations, except for urgent measures.

general.title: General provisions
general.content:
• Severability: the invalidity of one provision does not affect the others, which remain in force.
• No waiver: failure to enforce any obligation does not imply novation or waiver.
• Assignment: you may not assign this contract without our written consent. We may assign it in a corporate transaction, upon notice.
• Entire agreement: these terms, the Privacy Policy and the commercial agreement, where one exists, constitute the entire agreement between the parties.
• Languages: in case of discrepancy between translated versions, the Portuguese version prevails.
• Contact: {supportEmail} for support and contractual matters; {dpoEmail} for data protection.

DATA_REF_DANGLING.title: {node} uses data that will not be available
DATA_REF_DANGLING.fix: Use only data from steps that come before this one on the same path, or adjust the connections.

DATA_REF_NEVER_SET.title: {node} uses {ref} in {field}, data that nothing provides
DATA_REF_NEVER_SET.fix: Pick data from the list of variables available at this step, or add a step before it that sets this data. Without a value, that part is empty for the customer.

DATA_REF_SOME_PATHS.title: {node} uses {ref} in {field}, data that only some paths provide
DATA_REF_SOME_PATHS.fix: Make every path to this step go through a step that sets the data, or handle the empty value first.

DATA_REF_UNKNOWN_KEY.title: {node} uses data the source step does not provide
DATA_REF_UNKNOWN_KEY.fix: Pick the variable again from the list of available data.

EDGE_BAD_HANDLE_LABEL.title: {node} has a connection from an output that no longer exists
EDGE_BAD_HANDLE_LABEL.fix: Delete that connection and connect again from one of the step's current outputs.

EDGE_INVALID_REF.title: A connection points to a step that does not exist
EDGE_INVALID_REF.fix: Delete the loose connection and connect the steps again.

GRAPH_CYCLE_DETECTED.title: The flow loops back to an earlier step without a pause
GRAPH_CYCLE_DETECTED.fix: To repeat steps, add a wait or a loop on the way back and make sure the flow reaches an End.

GRAPH_DUPLICATE_NODE_ID.title: Two steps ended up with the same identifier
GRAPH_DUPLICATE_NODE_ID.fix: Delete one of the repeated steps and add it again.

GRAPH_DUPLICATE_TRIGGER_TYPE.title: The flow has two identical triggers
GRAPH_DUPLICATE_TRIGGER_TYPE.fix: Keep only one trigger of each kind.

GRAPH_EMPTY.title: The flow is empty
GRAPH_EMPTY.fix: Add a trigger, the flow's steps and an End.

GRAPH_INVALID_WORKFLOW_TYPE.title: The flow type is not valid
GRAPH_INVALID_WORKFLOW_TYPE.fix: Choose whether the flow handles messages or calls.

GRAPH_NO_END.title: No path finishes at an End
GRAPH_NO_END.fix: Add an End step and connect the last step of each path to it.

GRAPH_NO_TRIGGER.title: The flow has no trigger
GRAPH_NO_TRIGGER.fix: Add a trigger to set when the flow starts.

GRAPH_ORPHAN_NODE.title: {node} cannot be reached from the trigger
GRAPH_ORPHAN_NODE.fix: Connect this step to the flow or delete it.

GRAPH_STRUCTURE.title: The flow's connections have a problem
GRAPH_STRUCTURE.fix: Review the connections between the steps and save again.

GRAPH_TOO_MANY_EDGES.title: The flow has too many connections
GRAPH_TOO_MANY_EDGES.fix: Simplify the connections or split the flow into smaller flows.

GRAPH_TOO_MANY_NODES.title: The flow has too many steps
GRAPH_TOO_MANY_NODES.fix: Simplify the flow or split it into smaller flows.

NODE_AGENT_CALL_INPUTS_INVALID.title: {node} has invalid input fields
NODE_AGENT_CALL_INPUTS_INVALID.fix: Give each field a unique name using only lowercase letters, digits and _, and pick a type from the list.

NODE_CODE_READS_TEMPLATE.title: {node} uses a variable in braces inside the code
NODE_CODE_READS_TEMPLATE.fix: Braces are not replaced inside code. Read the value from the earlier steps' data; the suggestion shows how.

NODE_CONFIG_SHAPE_MISMATCH.title: {node} has {field} in a format that does not work
NODE_CONFIG_SHAPE_MISMATCH.fix: Open the step, fill in that field again and save.

NODE_CONSENT_GRANT_NEEDS_REPLY.title: {node} records consent before the lead replies
NODE_CONSENT_GRANT_NEEDS_REPLY.fix: Place this step after the lead's reply on every path (Wait for reply, a button option or the template button). For an opt-out, use Withdraw.

NODE_FIELD_OUT_OF_RANGE.title: {node} has {field} outside the allowed range
NODE_FIELD_OUT_OF_RANGE.fix: Set a value between the field's minimum and maximum.

NODE_INCOMPATIBLE_SCOPE.title: {node} cannot be used in this type of flow
NODE_INCOMPATIBLE_SCOPE.fix: Delete this step or replace it with one that works in this type of flow.

NODE_INVALID_CONFIG_VALUE.title: {node} has an invalid option in {field}
NODE_INVALID_CONFIG_VALUE.fix: Open the step and pick one of the options in the list.

NODE_INVALID_DTMF_CONFIG.title: {node} has invalid keys
NODE_INVALID_DTMF_CONFIG.fix: Pick at least one key from 0 to 9, * or #, without repeats.

NODE_INVALID_INTERACTIVE_CONFIG.title: {node} has invalid options
NODE_INVALID_INTERACTIVE_CONFIG.fix: Use up to 3 buttons or up to 10 list items, each with its own title and no repeats. Buttons take up to 20 characters.

NODE_INVALID_RESOURCE_REF.title: {node} uses an item that is no longer available
NODE_INVALID_RESOURCE_REF.fix: Pick it again: the item was deleted, belongs to another workspace or cannot be used yet, such as a template that is not approved.

NODE_INVALID_TOOL_PARAM_TYPE.title: {node} has a tool parameter with an invalid type
NODE_INVALID_TOOL_PARAM_TYPE.fix: Open the step's tools and pick a type from the list for each parameter.

NODE_INVALID_TYPE.title: {node} is of a type that does not exist
NODE_INVALID_TYPE.fix: Delete this step and add an equivalent one from the list of steps.

NODE_MISSING_REQUIRED_FIELD.title: {node}: {field} still needs to be filled in
NODE_MISSING_REQUIRED_FIELD.fix: Open the step and fill in the required fields.

NODE_MISSING_REQUIRED_OUTPUT.title: {node}: {output} needs a connection
NODE_MISSING_REQUIRED_OUTPUT.fix: Connect each output of this step to the next step or to an End.

NODE_MISSING_RESOURCE_REF.title: {node}: {field} still needs to be chosen
NODE_MISSING_RESOURCE_REF.fix: Without it the step does nothing. Open the step and pick an item from the list.

NODE_NO_INCOMING.title: {node} receives no connection
NODE_NO_INCOMING.fix: Connect an earlier step to this one, or delete it if it is not used.

NODE_NO_OUTGOING.title: {node} has nowhere to go next
NODE_NO_OUTGOING.fix: Connect this step's output to the next step or to an End.

NODE_PINNED_OUTPUT.title: {node} has its output pinned for tests
NODE_PINNED_OUTPUT.fix: In tests this step returns the pinned output without running. Publishing removes it and the step runs again.

NODE_PIN_INVALID.title: {node} has an invalid pinned output
NODE_PIN_INVALID.fix: Fix or remove this step's pinned output.

NODE_REASONING_UNSUPPORTED.title: {node} uses a reasoning level the model does not offer
NODE_REASONING_UNSUPPORTED.fix: Pick another level or keep the model's default.

NODE_REPLY_TO_AGENT_WITHOUT_AGENT_TRIGGE.title: {node} only works in flows called by an AI agent
NODE_REPLY_TO_AGENT_WITHOUT_AGENT_TRIGGE.fix: Add the Called by AI agent trigger or delete this step.

NODE_SECRET_IN_PLAIN_TEXT.title: {node} keeps a password or key as plain text in {field}
NODE_SECRET_IN_PLAIN_TEXT.fix: Store the value in the workspace secrets and use the secret instead. Anyone who opens the flow can read the text.

NODE_SEGMENTED_SEND_CONFLICT.title: {node} sends messages twice
NODE_SEGMENTED_SEND_CONFLICT.fix: In segmented mode the AI agent sends its own messages. Delete the text send right after it.

NODE_UNKNOWN_CONFIG_KEY.title: {node} has a setting that is not recognized: {field}
NODE_UNKNOWN_CONFIG_KEY.fix: It is ignored when the flow runs. Check that the step does what you expect.

SEND_OUTSIDE_WINDOW_RISK.title: {node} sends a free-form message that may fall outside the 24 h window
SEND_OUTSIDE_WINDOW_RISK.fix: This path starts at a trigger that usually runs with the window closed, so the send fails in production. Send a template first or wait for the contact's reply.

TRIGGER_HAS_INCOMING_EDGE.title: {node} receives a connection, but triggers only start the flow
TRIGGER_HAS_INCOMING_EDGE.fix: Delete the connection that reaches the trigger.

TRIGGER_INCOMPATIBLE_WITH_TYPE.title: {node} does not match this flow's type
TRIGGER_INCOMPATIBLE_WITH_TYPE.fix: Replace the trigger with a compatible one or change the flow type.

TRIGGER_NOT_CONNECTED.title: {node} is not connected to the flow
TRIGGER_NOT_CONNECTED.fix: Connect the trigger's output to the first step of the flow.

WORKFLOW_INVALID.title: The flow details are incomplete
WORKFLOW_INVALID.fix: Give the flow a name and save again.

WORKFLOW_VOICE_TRUNK_INVALID.title: The flow's phone line is not available
WORKFLOW_VOICE_TRUNK_INVALID.fix: Pick a phone line in this workspace that receives calls.

NODE_INVALID_PLATFORM_EMAIL.title: {node} has an invalid platform email
NODE_INVALID_PLATFORM_EMAIL.fix: Choose Text with the email text, or Saved design with a design from the list. The sender and the design are picked from the list, not from variables.

NODE_INVALID_CARRIER_MESSAGE.title: {node} has an invalid RCS or SMS message
NODE_INVALID_CARRIER_MESSAGE.fix: Pick RCS with a sender and a message, or SMS with a sender and a text of up to 8 parts. Use workflow variables like '{{lead_name}}'; numbered variables like '{{1}}' only work in campaigns.

NODE_SHEET_MAPPING_INVALID.title: {node}: the columns do not match the spreadsheet
NODE_SHEET_MAPPING_INVALID.fix: Open the step and fill the required columns. Clear values from columns that were archived or removed.

NODE_INVALID_WEBHOOK_TRIGGER.title: {node} has an invalid webhook setup
NODE_INVALID_WEBHOOK_TRIGGER.fix: In Start on, choose Conversation or Lead. In Accepted events, leave it empty to accept all or list the event names.

NODE_NEEDS_CONVERSATION.title: {node} needs a conversation, but this workflow starts on a lead
NODE_NEEDS_CONVERSATION.fix: Workflows that start on a lead (Birthday, or Webhook starting on Lead) have no open conversation, so this step has no effect. Use steps that work without a conversation, such as email, CRM and HTTP request.

intro.conversation: An external system starts this workflow with an HTTP request. The body must say which conversation the workflow runs on: by entry_id + entry_type, or by phone. The reference below builds the call for you.

reference.title: How to call this webhook

exampleLabel.conversation: How the example identifies the conversation
exampleLabel.lead: How the example identifies the lead

reference.dirty: The example uses the saved settings. Save your changes to see them here.
reference.placeholderHint: {placeholder} is a placeholder. Use “Include secret” to copy the command already filled in.
reference.authNone: No authentication: any call with the right URL starts the workflow. Treat the URL as a secret.
reference.authHmac: Sign the exact body bytes with HMAC SHA256 and send the result in {header} as {digest}. Without the {prefix} prefix verification fails with 401.
reference.authToken: Send the token, without a prefix, in the {header} header.

intro.conversation: The body is JSON and identifies the conversation in one of these two ways.
intro.lead: The body is JSON and identifies the lead in one of these two ways.

options.entry: When the external system already knows the internal conversation id.
options.phone: Resolves to the most recent WhatsApp conversation with that number.
options.leadPhone: Finds the lead by phone. If it does not exist yet, it is created with the name sent.
options.leadEmail: Finds an existing lead by email. No lead is created.

fields.entry_id: Internal conversation id. Only valid together with entry_type.
fields.phone: Number in E.164 (+5511998887777). Alternative to the pair above; the Brazilian format with and without the ninth digit is accepted.
fields.leadPhone: Number in E.164 (+5511998887777). If no lead has this phone, a new lead is created.
fields.name: Name used only when the lead is created. An existing lead keeps its name.
fields.email: Email of an existing lead. Alternative to the phone; without a lead with this email, the call is refused.
fields.event: Event name, such as pedido_pago. Optional. When Accepted events is filled in, the event must be on the list; others are ignored.
fields.external_id: Event id in your system. The same event with the same external_id runs the workflow only once.

body.extra: Any other field sent is kept and available in the workflow at {variable}.

responses.accepted: Run created; the run_id comes in the response.
responses.ignored: The event is not in Accepted events. Nothing started and the call is logged as ignored.

alreadyRunning.conversation: A run is already active for this conversation on this trigger.
alreadyRunning.lead: A run is already active for this lead on this trigger.

badRequest.conversation: Body without entry_id + entry_type and without phone.
badRequest.lead: Body without phone and without email.

responses.unauthorized: Missing or wrong token, or invalid signature.
responses.forbidden: The conversation does not belong to this workspace.

notFound.conversation: Webhook missing or turned off, or no conversation for the phone.
notFound.lead: Webhook missing or turned off, or no lead with the email sent.

responses.methodNotAllowed: Method differs from the configured one.
responses.notActive: The workflow is not active. Use Activate in the editor.
responses.noTrigger: The workflow has no webhook trigger node.
responses.capacity: The workspace limit of simultaneous runs was reached.
responses.retries: Resends. A repeated call is ignored for 6 h. The key comes from X-Idempotency-Key (or X-Webhook-Id or X-Event-Id); without these headers it is the body hash, so two legitimate calls with an identical body count as one. Send one of them to control this.
responses.leadPhoneInvalid: The phone sent is not a valid phone number.
responses.triggerInvalid: The webhook trigger setup is invalid.

threshold.hint: It only marks; nothing is paused and nobody is blocked. A comment whose severity is at or above this value (0 to 100) shows up in the "Need a reply" list, with its text and author, alongside questions, complaints and support requests. Every other comment keeps being analysed as usual.

When the limit is reached, analysis pauses until the next day and you get a notice; whatever arrives after that waits in the queue and is analysed when the day turns. A viral post never produces a bill nobody approved.

metaServiceCosts.title: Meta's new WhatsApp costs
metaServiceCosts.excerpt: From 1 October 2026, replying to a customer has a price. This article shows, message by message, which replies Meta starts charging for and which stay free.
metaServiceCosts.lead: From 1 October 2026, replying to a customer has a price.
metaServiceCosts.standfirst: Below are three real conversations with every message marked: what Meta starts charging for in October, what is billed separately, and what stays free.
metaServiceCosts.metaTitle: Meta's new WhatsApp costs: what changes on 1 October 2026
metaServiceCosts.metaDescription: Free-form replies inside the 24-hour window become billable, and utility templates inside that window stop being free. With visual examples of exactly which messages are charged.

announcement.title: What Meta announced
announcement.body1: On 1 October 2026 the largest WhatsApp Business billing change since July 2025 takes effect. Two things that are free today become chargeable: the free-form reply your team sends inside the 24-hour window, which Meta calls a service message, and the utility template sent inside that same window. Until 30 September 2026 both remain free.
announcement.body2: The decision is Meta's, and it applies to every business using the official WhatsApp Business API, in any country and through any provider. It is not a price change by your customer-service platform: Meta sets the category of each message, the rate for each country and the start date, and every provider passes on exactly the same cost. The bill this article walks through would be identical on any other tool on the market.
announcement.body3: What is not changing matters just as much, and it is what keeps this in proportion. Messages customers send to a business stay free, today and after October, with no cap at all. The 24-hour window still exists and is still opened by the customer. Conversations that start from a Click-to-WhatsApp ad still get 72 entirely free hours. What changes is narrower than the headlines suggest, and that is where this article starts.

callout.title: Who decides and who charges
callout.body: Meta sets the message categories, the per-country rates and the dates. The API provider only passes the amount on. No customer-service platform can exempt a message Meta has classified as chargeable, or offer a rate different from Meta's official table.

window.title: The 24-hour window
window.intro: Every rule hangs off one clock. When the customer writes, a 24-hour window opens, and a service message only exists inside it.

clock.panelScenario: The green line is the time the window stays open.

steps.body: Inbound messages are never charged, and this is what opens the window.
A free-form reply with no template. It is a service message, and from October it is charged.
Still inside the window. Every free-form reply counts as one message.
24 hours after the customer's last message.
The only way back is an approved template, charged at its own category rate.

clock.foot: The clock restarts with every new customer message: the window is not 24 hours from first contact, it is 24 hours from the last message they sent.

window.body1: A service message is a free-form reply, meaning text, image, audio or document with no approved template, sent by the business inside that window. It makes no difference who wrote it: human agent, chatbot or automation, the message is the same and so is the charge. What decides the category is the format and the moment it is sent, never its origin.
window.body2: Only the customer can open the window. A business cannot open one on its own, which is exactly why templates exist: outside the window, an approved template is the only way to reach anyone. It is also why the window restarts with every inbound message. A conversation that stretches over two days, with the customer replying now and then, keeps the window open the whole time, and every free-form reply in that period is a service message.
window.body3: In practice this means the cost of a support operation does not depend on how many conversations it has, but on how many times it speaks in each one. Two teams with identical conversation volumes can receive very different invoices if one answers in four short bubbles and the other in one complete reply.

examples.title: Three conversations, three bills
examples.intro: A written rule is one thing; an invoice is another. The three conversations below are the ones your team has every day, with every message marked the way Meta will classify it from October. The number at the top of each is how many messages Meta charges for.
examples.body: Read them in order. The first shows what an ordinary support case costs, handled well and expensive anyway. The second shows the same effort costing nothing, purely because the conversation started somewhere else. The third shows the part of the change almost nobody notices, because it happens inside a template that was always free.

matrix.title: What is charged, line by line
matrix.intro: This table answers the question everyone asks first: what actually changed. Of the seven rows, five stay exactly as they were. The two highlighted ones are the only ones that moved.
matrix.body: Notice that marketing and authentication are not among the changes. Those templates have always been charged and keep the same rate. What changed is how the 24-hour window is treated: it has stopped being a free space and has become simply the space where free-form replies are allowed. The permission remains, the free ride is over.

agentCallout.title: What about Meta Business Agent replies?
agentCallout.body: Since 1 August 2026 they are charged by tokens consumed rather than per message. A non-template message is charged once and only once: either as a service message or as a Meta Business Agent message, never as both.

actions.title: What changes day to day
actions.intro: Two situations that cost nothing today and carry a price from 1 October. Neither depends on a system change: it is the same conversation, with a different figure on the invoice.

steps.title: A reply split into three bubbles is three charges
steps.body: Three bubbles in a row are three charged messages. The same information written as one complete reply is one.

steps.title: First contact from an ad opens 72 free hours
steps.body: A conversation opened by a Click-to-WhatsApp ad or a Page button opens 72 free hours, provided the business replies within 24 hours. Inside that window nothing is charged, templates included.

deadline.title: 1 October 2026 is the date that matters
deadline.body: That is when a free-form reply inside the window starts being charged. Until 30 September the same message costs nothing.

page.title: WebChat
page.description: Put a chat on your website and serve visitors in the same inbox, with AI or with your team.

rows.graphAxis: In the graph: drag on one axis

transitions.title: Transition
transitions.addAt: Add a transition on this cut
transitions.panelHint: Pick a type to apply it on the selected clip's cut or the cut nearest the playhead. Clips do not move.
transitions.swapHint: Pick another type to swap the selected transition.

hints.dissolve: One clip blends into the other
hints.dipToColor: Passes through a color in the middle, like a fade to black
hints.push: The new clip pushes the old one out
hints.slide: One clip slides over the other
hints.wipe: An edge sweeps across revealing the new clip
hints.iris: The new clip opens from a shape
hints.clockWipe: Sweeps the frame like a clock hand
hints.split: The new clip opens from the center to the edges
hints.zoom: Zooms in until the clip changes, with blur
hints.whip: A fast pass with motion blur
hints.blurDissolve: A dissolve with blur in the middle
hints.constantPower: One sound fades out as the other comes in, with no dip in the middle
hints.constantGain: A straight crossfade, for similar sounds that could add up too much
hints.gradientWipe: The clip appears in the order of a tone map, dark to light
hints.venetianBlinds: The clip opens in slats, like blinds
hints.blockDissolve: The clip appears in loose blocks across the frame
hints.radialWipe: The clip opens like a fan, both ways at once

moves.in: New clip slides in on top
moves.out: Old clip slides out on top

transitions.mapPicture: Use an image as the map

textMotion.title: Text animation
textMotion.hint: Each letter, word or line starts after the one before; the stagger is that delay. The exit ends with the clip.

speed.title: Speed
speed.frozen: This clip is a freeze frame. Change its length by dragging its edges on the timeline.
speed.pitchHint: Far from 1× stretched sound can feel artificial. Turn off Keep sound pitch to let the sound follow the speed.

ramp.hint: The speed changes gradually from the playhead and the rest of the clip plays at the target speed.
ramp.smoothHint: The speed changes continuously from the playhead and keeps the new speed until the clip ends.

speed.targetDurationHint: Changes the speed so the clip lasts this long, without cutting anything.
speed.protectEdgesHint: Keys near the start and the end keep their timing; only the middle of the animation stretches.
speed.groupHint: A group plays its content at one constant speed, never reversed. The sound inside follows that speed and keeps its pitch.
speed.frameMixHint: In slow motion, blends the two neighbouring source frames so motion does not stutter.

curve.title: Speed curve
curve.hint: Click to add a point, drag to change the speed; double click or Delete removes it.
curve.keepHint: The curve plays the same part of the media and the length changes; with Keep duration, the length stays and the media follows.

trackSound.triggers: Duck when there is speech on
trackSound.noOtherTracks: Add another audio track with the speech so this track can duck by itself.
trackSound.hint: The track dips before each phrase and comes back after it. Bake turns the rule into volume keys you can adjust one by one.

line.title: Line
line.sequential: Draw the strokes one after another
line.interpolatedHint: Animated: the value comes from the keys
line.hint: Wave speed and wiggles per second move the line by themselves. To draw the stroke on, animate the end from 0% to 100%.
line.outsideHint: Move the playhead inside the clip to add keys.
line.unavailable: Only lines and outlined shapes animate their stroke. Remove the layer's shadow and effects to turn it on.

masks.title: Masks
masks.empty: No masks. A mask shows only part of the clip.
masks.interpolatedHint: Animated: the value comes from the keys
masks.matteHint: The clip shows only where the visible clip right below has picture.
masks.outsideHint: Move the playhead inside the clip to add keys.
masks.pathHint: Coordinates from 0 to 1 inside the mask box.
masks.matteLumaHint: Brightness: the light parts of the clip below show this clip and the dark parts hide it.
masks.matteInvertHint: Inverted: the clip shows where the clip below has no picture, or where it is dark.
masks.effectHint: On an effect clip, the mask limits the adjustment to the shape: everything outside stays as it was.

vfx.title: Effects
vfx.empty: No effects. Grain, light and motion go here.
vfx.emptyEffectClip: This effect clip is empty. Pick an effect above.

hints.grain: Film texture that changes every frame.
hints.lightLeak: Warm light patches drifting across the picture.
hints.particles: Floating specks of light, dust or snow.
hints.shake: Handheld camera, from light to strong.
hints.vignette: Darkens the edges and draws the eye to the center.
hints.chromaticAberration: Splits the colors near the edges.
hints.glow: Bright areas radiate light around them.
hints.posterize: Reduces the tones, like a poster.
hints.mirror: Reflects one half of the image onto the other.
hints.offset: Shifts the image, which wraps around the edge.
hints.directionalBlur: A streak in one direction, like speed.
hints.zoomBlur: Streaks leaving a point, like a fast zoom.
hints.waveWarp: Bends the image in traveling waves.
hints.ripple: Circular waves, like a drop in water.
hints.twirl: Twists the image in a spiral around a point.
hints.bulge: Swells or pinches the image like a lens.
hints.cornerPin: Pins the four corners anywhere, to fit a screen.
hints.fractalNoise: Moving clouds and smoke, great for backgrounds.
hints.gradientRamp: A linear or radial gradient between two colors.
hints.audioSpectrum: Bars that follow the frequencies of a sound track.
hints.audioWaveform: The loudness of a sound track drawn as a moving wave.
hints.posterizeTime: Shows fewer frames per second, like stop motion.
hints.echo: Repeats the clip behind itself in a fading trail.

vfx.interpolatedHint: Animated: the value comes from the keys
vfx.outsideHint: Move the playhead inside the clip to add keys.
vfx.pacedHint: Pace values take no keys; they stay the same across the clip so the effect never jumps.
vfx.strengthHint: Applies to everything on the tracks below. Fade in and fade out also dose the effect.
vfx.panelHint: Adds an effect clip at the playhead; it applies to everything on the tracks below. To change a single clip, open Effects in the inspector.
vfx.adjustmentHint: An empty effect clip at the playhead, to give color, blur, a camera and a mask to everything below.
vfx.needsSound: Needs an audio track in the project.
vfx.notOnEffectClips: Works on a clip only: select the clip and add it from the inspector.

meters.masterClipped: Clipping on the master output. Click to clear

sound.limited: The gain reached its maximum and the sound is still below the target.

mixer.label: Mixer
mixer.faderHint: Double click to go back to 0 dB
mixer.empty: Add an audio track to mix.

layout.title: Align in frame
layout.hintOne: Aligns the clip in the frame at the playhead. An animated position gets a key there.
layout.hintSeveral: Aligns to the box around the clips or to the frame. Distribute needs three clips. Clips with an animated position get a key at the playhead.

timing.title: Sequence
timing.gapHint: Places the clips one after another in the order you selected them. A negative gap overlaps clips on different tracks.
timing.orderHint: The first selected clip stays put; linked sound follows its video.

counter.title: Counter
counter.hint: The text becomes a number that counts from one value to another, like 0 to 10,000 customers.
counter.interpolatedHint: Animated: the value comes from the keys

textPath.title: Text on a path
textPath.hint: The letters follow a curve: arc, circle, wave or your own path.
textPath.pathHint: Coordinates from 0 to 1 in the clip box; the text follows the first stroke.
textPath.interpolatedHint: Animated: the position comes from the keys
textPath.slideHint: Animate the position from below 0% to above 100% to make the text run along the path. On an open path, letters disappear at the ends.

parenting.title: Parent
parenting.hint: The clip follows the parent's position, rotation and scale around the parent's anchor point. Opacity is not inherited. While parented, position, size and rotation are read in the parent's space.
parenting.selectChildren: Select {count, plural, one {# child} other {# children}}
parenting.whip: Drag onto another clip to parent. Shift on release: jump to the parent. Alt click: release
parenting.whipFollowing: Follows {name}. Drag onto another clip to change. Alt click: release
parenting.addNullHint: An invisible controller that moves, turns and scales the clips parented to it

graph.hint: Drag keys in time and value and drag the handles to change the curve; with Alt the arrival and departure split, with Shift the drag stays on one axis. With the graph focused, the arrows move the selected keys (left and right one frame, up and down the value) or the chosen handle (left and right the influence, up and down the speed). Shift moves ten times more and Esc goes back to the keys.
graph.singleKey: a single key, no curve yet

empty.value: No number property is animated. Color has no graph, and a position path shows in the speed graph.
empty.speed: No animated property has a speed to show. Color has no speed graph.

announce.select: Select keys in the graph first.
announce.speedKeys: In the speed graph keys only move in time.
announce.noHandle: The selected keys have no {side} handle.

textAnimators.title: Text animators
textAnimators.empty: No animators. Pick a preset or create one to move, turn, scale, color or space each letter, word or line.
textAnimators.noProperties: No properties yet; add one below.
textAnimators.visualLabel: How much each of the {count} units gets right now
textAnimators.seedHint: Seed {seed} (0 to {max}); shuffle changes the random order or the wiggle.
textAnimators.outsideHint: Move the playhead inside the clip to record keys.
textAnimators.hint: Animators add position, turn, blur and spacing and multiply scale and opacity, in list order. Animate the offset to reveal in sequence.

behaviors.title: Behaviors
behaviors.empty: Behaviors animate a property on their own: wiggle, loop the keys, move or spin forever, bounce when arriving at a key or pulse with the sound. Pick the property and the behavior.
behaviors.hint: The behavior adds to the keyed value and looks the same in the preview and the export. Bake into keys turns it into ordinary keys, one per frame.
behaviors.needsKeys: Needs at least two keys on this property to have an effect.

tracking.title: Tracking
tracking.hint: Click a detail with contrast in the video (an eye, a corner, a letter) and track it. Then make a text, sticker or null follow the point, or stabilize the shot.
tracking.stabilizeHint: Lock keeps the point still; smooth removes shake and keeps the camera move. The zoom hides the edges.
tracking.aimHint: Click the point to follow; drag to change the area size

groups.backHint: Back to the level above (Shift + Enter)
groups.title: Group
groups.hint: Position, keys, masks, effects, blend, transitions, speed and trim on the group apply to the picture of the whole group. Double click the group or press Enter to edit inside.
groups.soundHint: The group volume and fades apply to the sound of every track inside.

morph.title: Shape morph
morph.convertHint: Rectangles, ellipses, triangles and stars become an editable path on the first key.
morph.empty: Record a key, move the playhead to another moment and change the points: the shape morphs between the keys.
morph.hint: Shapes with different point counts are matched automatically. Pick the first vertex to make the shape turn as it morphs; each key's curve sets the pace.
morph.outsideHint: Move the playhead inside the clip to record shape keys.
morph.nodeHint: Drag to move; double click or Enter makes it the first vertex of the key at the playhead
morph.editHint: Drag the points and handles. Once the shape animates, each change records a key at the playhead. Double click a point: first vertex. Esc finishes.
morph.pathHint: Coordinates from 0 to 1 in the clip box. Once the shape animates, a change records a key at the playhead.

repeat.title: Repeater
repeat.hint: Live copies of the clip: change the original and all of them change. Pick a starting point.
repeat.outsideHint: Move the playhead inside the clip to record keys.

organize.title: Organization
organize.name: Clip name
organize.label: Label color
organize.guideHint: A guide shows in the preview and never goes into the export: safe area, reference or guide audio.
organize.markers: {count, plural, =0 {No markers on the clip} one {# marker on the clip} other {# markers on the clip}}
organize.markersHint: Clip markers move with the clip. Click one to go to it; edit it from its tick on the clip.
organize.beatCount: {count, plural, one {# beat marked} other {# beats marked}}
organize.beatsPlaced: {count, plural, one {# beat marked} other {# beats marked}} at {bpm} BPM.
organize.beatsHint: Reads the pulse of the music and marks each beat in the part that plays. Marking again replaces the earlier beats.

beatRefusals.noPulse: There is no clear pulse in this sound.
beatRefusals.outside: No beat falls in the part the clip plays.
beatRefusals.unread: The sound could not be read yet. Try again.

presets.title: Presets

timingHints.stretch: The whole animation stretches or shrinks to the clip length.
timingHints.edges: The entrance and exit keep their speed; only the middle stretches.
timingHints.keep: The original timing stays; anything past the clip end is cut.

presets.loadFailed: The presets could not be loaded.
presets.appliedWithout: {name} applied; {count, plural, one {# part was left out} other {# parts were left out}} because the clip cannot take them.

applyRefusals.invalid: The animation would push the clip out of bounds. Adjust its position or use another preset.

presets.savedWithout: Saved as {name}; {count, plural, one {# part does not go} other {# parts do not go}} into presets.

saveRefusals.notVisual: Only clips with a picture have an animation to save.
saveRefusals.nothing: This clip has no animation to save.
saveRefusals.name: Give it a name of 1 to 120 characters.
saveRefusals.failed: The server did not save the preset. Try again.

styles.mediaHint: Shadow, glow and outline follow the clip's silhouette: the picture edge, the cut of its masks and the transparent parts of PNG images. The diamond records the effect value at the playhead.
styles.overlayHint: Fills, outlines and effects just like in the image editor. The diamond beside an effect value records a key at the playhead, so a glow can pulse or a shadow can travel.

camera.title: Camera
camera.motionBlurHint: Blurs everything below while the camera pans, turns or zooms, using the project shutter.
camera.hint: The camera pans, zooms and turns everything on the tracks below. The clip strength and fades dose the camera, the color and the blur.

openFromMedia.unreadable: The media could not be read. Try again in a moment.

greeting.video: Shall we edit this video together?

description.video: I trim, caption, animate text and add music right on the timeline. You see my cursor and can undo any step with Ctrl+Z.
description.image: I build the layout, write the text, align the elements and remove backgrounds right on the canvas. You see my cursor and can undo any step with Ctrl+Z.

actions.attach_to_track: Making a clip follow the point

queue.title: In the queue
queue.following: Following {count, plural, one {# job} other {# jobs}} in the queue

hints.pen: Click to place points and drag to make curves. Shift snaps to 45 degrees, Alt breaks the handle. Click the first point to close. Backspace removes the last point, Enter or Esc finishes.
hints.draw: Draw with the mouse, a pen or your finger. Ending near the start closes the shape.
hints.edit: Drag points and handles. Double click a point to switch between curve and corner; on the outline, it adds a point. Delete removes the point, Alt breaks the handles, Shift locks the movement. Enter or Esc finishes.

inspector.convertHint: Becomes a vector shape with editable points.
inspector.fillRuleHint: Where the shape crosses itself stays open, like the middle of an O.

svg.imported: {count, plural, one {# shape imported} other {# shapes imported}}
svg.skipped: {count, plural, one {# unsupported item was left out} other {# unsupported items were left out}} (text, images or filters).
svg.invalid: This file is not a valid SVG.
svg.empty: The SVG has no shapes to import.
svg.tooLarge: The SVG is too large to fit in the project.
svg.copyFailed: Could not copy. Select shapes and try again.

trace.title: Trace image
trace.hint: Turns the photo or logo into editable vector shapes, on top of the image.
trace.done: {count, plural, one {Image traced into # shape} other {Image traced into # shapes}}
trace.nothing: There are no shapes to trace with these settings.
trace.failed: This image could not be traced.
trace.tooLarge: The result is too large. Use fewer colors, less detail or ignore larger specks.

stroke.patternHint: Dash and gap lengths in turn, separated by spaces, in multiples of the width. Example: 6 3 1 3.

issues.too_few: Select at least two shapes to combine.
issues.unsupported: Only shapes and vector paths can take part. Lines, arrows, text, icons and images are left out.
issues.empty: The shapes do not overlap, so the result would be empty.
issues.failed: This combination could not be computed. Try simplifying the shapes and repeat.
issues.too_large: The result would be too large for the project.
issues.invalid: The result does not fit the project rules, so nothing changed.
issues.unchanged: The path is already as simple as it gets.

chroma.title: Background key
chroma.intro: Removes the green or blue screen color behind the subject; what turns transparent shows the tracks below.
chroma.pick: Pick the screen color on screen
chroma.interpolatedHint: Animated: the value comes from the keys
chroma.lowChroma: This color is almost gray, so the key is unpredictable. Pick the green or blue screen color.
chroma.outsideHint: Move the playhead inside the clip to add keys.
chroma.holesHint: Holes in the subject: lower similarity. Screen left over: raise it. Colored edges: raise spill removal. If the subject wears the screen color, use a mask.
chroma.notFound: No green or blue background found at the edges. Choose the color or pick it with the eyedropper.
chroma.introLayer: Removes the green or blue screen color behind the person; what turns transparent shows the layers below.

inspector.noResults: No property matches "{query}" on this item.
inspector.results: {count, plural, one {# section found} other {# sections found}}

luma.title: Luma key
luma.intro: Removes the dark or light parts of the clip, such as the black background of light leaks, fire and particles; what turns transparent shows the tracks below.
luma.interpolatedHint: Animated: the value comes from the keys
luma.outsideHint: Move the playhead inside the clip to add keys.
luma.tuningHint: Background left over: raise the amount. Hard edge: raise the softness. For light over black, the Add blend often looks more natural.

hint.image: Click to insert on the artboard, or drag it where you want it.
hint.video: Click to insert at the playhead, or drag it onto the frame or the timeline.

library.noResultsHint: Try another word, in English or Portuguese.
library.emptyCategory: This category has nothing for this editor yet.
library.insertFailed: “{name}” could not load, so nothing was inserted. Try again.

hints.counter: A number that counts up to its final value

notes.framesImage: Drag a photo from your uploads into the frame, or select the frame and click the photo. Double click the photo to adjust how it sits in the frame.
notes.framesVideo: Select videos or images on the timeline and click a frame to crop them to its shape, or drag the frame onto the clip in the preview.
notes.gridsImage: The grid fills the artboard. Drag a photo into each cell.
notes.gridsVideo: Select the clips in the order of the cells and click a grid to split the screen between them.
notes.stickersImage: The image editor gets the last frame of the animation.
notes.qrCodes: Choose the content in the panel on the right. By default the code points to a {brandName} short link, which counts every scan.
notes.audio: Hover or focus a sound to hear it. Click to add it at the playhead or drag it onto a track.
notes.mockupsImage: Drag a photo from your uploads onto the device screen, or select the screen and click the photo.
notes.mockupsVideo: Select a video or image on the timeline and click a mockup to put it on the screen, or drag the mockup onto the clip in the preview.

generate.hint: Describe an object. The AI draws the picture and then removes the background, and the result is saved to your media library.
generate.placeholder: E.g. a rocket taking off with smoke

generate.blocked: Wait for a generation to finish before starting another.

curves.title: Curves
curves.hint: Click the curve to add a point and drag it to change the tone; double click or Delete removes it.

hsl.title: Selective color
hsl.hint: To keep one color, pick its hue and remove 100% from the rest. To change a color, shift its hue.

lut.title: LUT
lut.unreadable: This LUT could not be read. The preview shows stripes in its place, and export stays blocked until you import the file again or remove the LUT.
lut.hint: 3D .cube files from 2 to 65 points per channel, applied after the light and color adjustments.

faults.name: The file must end in .cube.
faults.rows: The table does not have the rows its size needs.
faults.number: A table row is not three numbers.
faults.keyword: The file has an unknown keyword.
faults.upload: The file could not be sent to the library.

pathOps.title: Path operators
pathOps.hint: They change the shape outline without destroying it: stack, reorder, hide or remove them anytime. They apply top to bottom.
pathOps.empty: No operators. Pick a preset or add one.
pathOps.pathHint: SVG with coordinates from 0 to 1 in the merge shape box.
pathOps.outsideHint: Move the playhead inside the clip to record keys.

live.title: Live merge
live.hint: The bottom shape takes the ones above as merge operators that stay editable.

chart.title: Chart
chart.refused: That change would make the chart invalid.
chart.expandHint: Turns the chart into plain shapes and text in a group; the data is no longer editable.

data.title: Create from data
data.hint: Type, paste cells from a spreadsheet with Ctrl+V or import a CSV file. The first row names the series and the first column names the categories.
data.label: Category of row {row}
data.invalid: Nothing to draw yet: the chart needs at least one row and one series of numbers.
data.scatterNeedsTwo: A scatter chart needs two series of numbers: the first one is the X axis.
data.importFailed: That file could not be read.
data.applyFailed: The data could not be applied.

motion.title: Chart animation
motion.hint: Grow raises the bars, Draw traces the lines, Sweep opens the pie and Fade brings parts in, one series or category at a time.

tables.title: Table
tables.refused: That change would make the table invalid.

cell.title: Text of one cell
cell.whole: Select part of the text to style only that part; with no selection, the whole cell changes

data.title: Table cells
data.hint: Type, paste cells from a spreadsheet with Ctrl+V or import a CSV file.
data.invalid: Not ready to apply yet: check the cell text.
data.importFailed: That file could not be read.
data.applyFailed: The cells could not be applied.

qr.title: QR Code

shortLink.title: Studio QR Code
shortLink.existing: Or use an existing short link
shortLink.hint: Every scan is counted in Links, with country and device.
shortLink.badTarget: Use a full address that starts with https://.
shortLink.failed: The short link could not be created.
shortLink.failedWith: The short link could not be created: {reason}
shortLink.refused: That link did not fit in the QR Code.

qr.phoneHint: Digits only, with country and area code, such as 5511999998888.
qr.urlHint: A direct link does not count scans. To count them, use the {brandName} short link.

logo.title: Center logo
logo.hint: Up to {max}% of the side at this level; the code grows to keep scanning.

problems.inverted: The modules must be darker than the background.
problems.quietZone: The margin needs at least 2 modules.

problems.logoEcc: The low level cannot hold a logo. Pick another level.
problems.logoSize: The logo is too big for this level.

qr.small: Each module is only {pixels} px in the export; make the code larger for at least {minimum} px per module.

blocked.noElo: You don't have access to Elo in this workspace
blocked.locked: Unlock the element to use this

prompts.eloRewrite: Rewrite this text, keeping the meaning and the tone of the design.
